mutants.name: the claim is never released at a pointercancel
expectRed: the claim is free again after a release, a pointercancel, an unmount
a pointercancel mid-drag releases the claim

mutants.name: the loop runs while the axis lock is y
expectRed: a vertical-locked drag held at the edge scrolls nothing

mutants.name: the scroller is found by computed overflow, not by its mark
mutants.replace: ((): HTMLElement | null => { for (let el = box.current?.parentElement ?? null; el; el = el.parentElement) { const overflowX = window.getComputedStyle(el).overflowX; if (overflowX === 'auto' || overflowX === 'scroll') return el; } return null; })()
